However, some people mentioned ongoing difficulties with customer support responses, experiencing frustrating delays and dealing with automated chat systems instead of real humans.See [...] ## Predatory billing, broken AI support, and immediate revocation of prepaid subscription benefits!
I am deeply appalled and disappointed by how ElevenLabs treats paying customers. If you are a creator, student, or professional relying on this platform for paid work, STAY AWAY.  
  
Here is a clear breakdown of how ElevenLabs operates:  
  
1. Account Held Hostage by a Billing Glitch: [...] ## Very disappointing experience
Very disappointing experience – Poor service and no customer support  
  
I paid $6 to add subtitles to my own video, but the exported result was completely unusable. My original voice had been altered, the audio and subtitles were out of sync, the captions appeared in the wrong position, and ElevenLabs branding was added throughout the video and at the end.  
  
I contacted ElevenLabs on September 8, the same day I paid, explained the problems, provided the video as evidence and requested a full refund.  
  
 I never received a response.   
  
I later discovered that what I understood to be a payment for a video export had actually been processed as a recurring subscription. By the time I noticed, I had been charged for two months.
